title: headcount-sync-org-planning-1on1-prep-scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for 1:1s + weekly headcount sync (engineering leadership + people ops). Focus: interview loop status, outstanding offers, hiring capacity, org changes, and next-step decisions.

Agenda for sync (30m):
- Quick status snapshot (5m) — open reqs + priority hires
- Interview loop / candidate blockages (10m) — which loops need changes
- Budget & approvals (5m) — finance gating items to resolve
- Decisions + owners (10m) — who sends offers, who escalates

Quick headcount snapshot (as of 2026-03-02):
- Total open reqs for serving-runtime: 6 (3 SWE II, 2 SWE III, 1 SRE III)
- Active pipeline: 11 candidates in active stages across reqs
- Recruiting capacity: 0.6 FTE dedicated; need to request +0.4 FTE from recruiting for spike
- Hiring freeze: none currently; finance sign-off pending for two new budgeted slots (SWE III)

Priority roles (top 3):
1) SWE III — model runtime (priority: throughput & quantization perf)
   - 3 candidates in loop: A (onsite next week), B (take-home review), C (pipeline cold)
   - Feedback from loop: interviewers flag coding question too focused on algorithmic puzzles vs systems design -> suggests change to loop exercise
2) SWE II — infra batching / KV cache work
   - Good pipeline but slow take-home turnaround (avg 6 days). Need recruiter nudges
3) SRE III — production latency & rollout experience
   - 1 strong candidate (D) with offer expected if comp sign-off happens

Interview loop notes / proposed tweaks:
- SWE III loop: replace one algorithmic question with a real-world systems design exercise (30m) focusing on model KV cache and latency tradeoffs. 
  - Rationale: better signal for day-1 impact; several interviewers already asking runtime design questions ad-hoc.
  - Action: update loop doc + scorecard by EOD Fri. Owner: Maya.
- Take-home assignments: reduce expected completion to 48–72h window and provide clearer rubric to speed reviewer feedback. Owner: Recruiting (Luis) to implement.
- Panel composition: ensure at least one senior perf engineer on onsite for SWE III (currently missing on candidate B). Owner: Jordan to schedule.

Candidate debrief shorthand (recent interviews):
- Candidate A (SWE III): strong on systems, medium coding; wants sign by 3/15; comp expectation 180–200k + equity.
- Candidate B (SWE III): strong ML infra background; slow on take-home; request longer onsite.
- Candidate D (SRE III): excellent on incident triage & rollout automation; awaiting comp approval from finance.

Open blockers / risks:
- Finance: still needs to OK two SWE III budget lines (ticket JIRA-HR-342). If not cleared by 3/10, risk delaying offers to final candidates.
- Recruiter bandwidth: only 0.6 FTE assigned; we should request surge support to avoid losing candidates.
- Interviewer availability for onsite windows in late March (several team members OOO).

Questions for 1:1s with direct reports / hiring managers:
- Are there candidates we should escalate (fast-track offers)? Who?
- Which roles can be deferred if finance says no? Prioritization (SWE III > SWE II > SRE III?)
- Any internal transfers we can surface to reduce requisitions?
- Feedback on loop exercise swap — objections?

Decisions needed at sync:
- Approve updated SWE III interview exercise and updated scorecard (quick poll in meeting).
- Approve recruiter surge request (+0.4 FTE) pending SLT approval. Owner: Jordan to draft request and loop in Priya.
- Confirm offer authority & sign-off flow for urgent candidates (who signs comp & who approves equity).

Action items (clear owners + due dates):
- Maya: Draft updated SWE III loop exercise and scorecard; circulate to interviewers. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Luis: Implement take-home rubric and reduce expected completion window; send to recruiting team. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Jordan: Add senior perf engineer to panel for candidate B and reserve onsite slot 3/22. Due: 2026-03-03.
- Jordan: Draft recruiter surge request (+0.4 FTE) and send to Priya for SLT escalation. Due: 2026-03-04.
- Priya: Check with finance re: JIRA-HR-342 and confirm budget OK or rollback plan. Due: 2026-03-09.
- Recruiting: Nudge candidates on take-home deadlines (automate reminders). Ongoing.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize time-to-offer as a metric: target < 10 days from final onsite to offer.
- Frame recruiter surge as cost-saving (reduce ghosting & pipeline drop-off -> faster hires).
- For comp conversations, align against market comp doc (link in confluence) and be conservative with equity for mid-level roles.

Follow-ups after weekly sync (what I'll do immediately):
- Update loop doc + scorecard PR (link in Slack #hiring-loop).
- Ping finance in 1:1 with Priya; ask for explicit deadline for budget sign-off.
- Confirm interview panel availability and block calendars for next two on-sites.

Rough timeline (recommended):
- This week (3/2–3/6): finalize loop changes, recruiter surge request, take-home rubric.
- Next week (3/9–3/13): push offers for A & D if budget cleared; schedule on-sites for others.
- By 3/22: expect first hire start dates (assuming 2-week notice + offer ext by 3/10).

Misc notes / links to update after meeting:
- Confluence: update 'Serving Runtime hiring' page with revised loop and candidate tracker.
- GH: create PR for loop exercise template (repo: hiring-assets).
- Slack: post short summary to #eng-hiring with next steps + owners.

Scratchy thoughts (keep for follow-up):
- Consider internal rotation program for junior infra folks — could reduce external hires by 1.
- Explore contractor-to-hire for short-term throughput on KV cache work. Cost vs ramp tradeoff.

End of notes.
